items.organizationName: TR-CERT (Computer Emergency Response Team of the Republic of Türkiye)
items.scope: Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Jamf issues and Jamf Open Source.
Vulnerabilities in products and services under the Canon brand.
Vulnerabilities identified in Cribl products, and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Cribl that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Siemens issues only.
All EnterpriseDB products and vulnerabilities identified in open source libraries used by EnterpriseDB products unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Supported Secomea products only.
Samsung Mobile Galaxy products, personal computers, and related services only.
Vulnerabilities in linqi products only.
NVIDIA issues only.
All rami.io GmbH products and open source projects, including pretix, official pretix plugins and apps, and Venueless.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities discovered by Project Black that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.

Vulnerabilities in Delinea products or services listed on delinea.com, or vulnerabilities in third-party products or services discovered by or reported to Delinea, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
Yokogawa Group companies’ products and Yokogawa Group subsidiaries’ products.
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by ZUSO ART that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Carrier Global products only.
Jaspersoft products and services only.
All CrowdStrike products.
Vulnerabilities discovered by, reported to, or coordinated by, SCHUTZWERK unless covered by another CNA.
Juniper issues only.
JetBrains products only.
Adobe issues only.
SICK AG issues and issues in EHS products (when related to the Endress+Hauser SICK (EHS) joint venture).
Bosch products only.

All Trellix Enterprise (formerly McAfee Enterprise and FireEye) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Trellix Advanced Research Center (Trellix ACR) that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All products of 2N Telekomunikace a.s. including end-of-life/end-of-service products.
Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
All ESET products only and vulnerabilities discovered by ESET that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Gridware software, services, and infrastructure issues, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to Gridware researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Schneider Electric products, including Proface, APC, and ProLeiT.
End of life open source projects supported by HeroDevs if hosted on HeroDevs.com, or issues in open source projects discovered by or reported to HeroDevs, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All HYPR products only.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.
All Payara Platform product distributions (Payara Server, Micro, Embedded) for both Enterprise (commercial) and Community (OSS) distributions.
All OpenText products (including Carbonite, Zix, Micro Focus, others).
Dell, Dell EMC, and VCE issues only.
Qualcomm and Snapdragon issues only.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by DIVD, and vulnerabilities reported to DIVD for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
Kaspersky B2C and B2B products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered in third-party software not in another CNA’s scope.
Xerox Corporation issues only.
Vivo issues only.
Kong products; Kong Konnect, Kong Enterprise, Kong Mesh, and Kong Insomnia, including Kong Opensource; Kong Gateway, Kuma, Insomnia.
Vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to Toreon that are not in another CNA’s scope.
